title: KAITO — Brand New Wonderland〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, what to do today?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Thanks to the others' help, we were able to check and get through all of the props decently fast...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe, looks like I have some free time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm?
There's a box in the stage wings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I wonder what's in this box. It looks similar to the ones we stored the props in, but we've put those away already...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, there's a piece of paper on the lid.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: “DO NOT OPEN THIS, KAITO! NO MATTER WHAT!!!”?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: AAAHH!!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whoa! Rin! Len!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: K-KAITO! What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That box! Did you open it?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: N-No, it's okay. I haven't opened it. I mean, it says I'm not allowed to on the lid.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um... Is this box yours?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Y-Yup♪ There's a bunch of toys in there! Right, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y-Yeah! Super duper important toys!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I have a feeling that there are no toys in here, but... Probably best to not dig any further.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO. I found you.

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: KAITO! There's something we need you for!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Please come over here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? You want me to take a nap with everyone?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Apparently, the plushies have been having trouble sleeping lately...

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: We thought maybe having someone with us would make us sleep much better.

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line:
Please, KAITO.
Could you please nap with us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Would you mind? I'm not able to get them all to sleep without falling asleep myself first.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hahahah. I see.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, I don't have anything to do today, so I don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Plushie A & Plushie B
rows.Line: Hurray!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Great! Alright everyone, let's all get comfy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Good niiight...

rows.Speaker: Plushie A & Plushie B
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Good night...

rows.Speaker: Plushie A & Plushie B
rows.Line: Zzz...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Hold on... They said that they haven't been able to sleep recently, but they went out like a light just now...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Hehe. Maybe they were affected by Luka's yawn.)

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: KAITO! Thank you for taking a nap with us!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
It's been a while since I had a nap as well. It was nice.

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Really? That's great!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehehe. Since Operation Nap Time was a success, we should start heading over.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO's here!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Nice timing! We just finished preparing♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Preparing? What for?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ Here we go, everyone! Ready... Go!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: KAITO! Thank you for always looking out for us!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for all of the things you do behind the scenes, like checking the props the other day☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The reason we're able to have fun putting on shows is thanks to you, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for always considering Miku's and my ideas, despite how ridiculous they may be♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehehe. Just like the nap we took before, make sure to take a nice break and relax.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think I'll do just that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now let's head over to the spot for our “KAITO Appreciation Party”♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me and Len worked hard on the decorations♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We freaked out when we saw that you found the box with the decorations in it, but I'm glad the surprise was a success!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. So that's why you had a label that told me specifically to not open it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's exactly right! Anyway, c'mon let's go!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. You don't have to pull so hard. I'll be right there with you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Thank you, everyone. This makes me so happy.)
